text_en: They came to the other side of the sea, to the country of the Gerasenes.
text_cn: 他们来到了海的对岸革辣撒人的地方。

text_en: And when he had stepped out of the boat, immediately a man out of the tombs with an unclean spirit met him.
text_cn: 耶稣一下船，即刻有一个附邪魔的人，从坟墓里出来， 迎着他走来，

text_en: He lived among the tombs; and no one could restrain him any more, even with a chain;
text_cn: 原来那人居住在坟墓里，再没有人能捆住他，就是用锁链也不能，

text_en: for he had often been restrained with shackles and chains, but the chains he wrenched apart, and the shackles he broke in pieces; and no one had the strength to subdue him.
text_cn: 因为人屡次用脚镣和锁链将他捆缚，他却将锁链挣断，将脚镣弄碎，没有人能制伏他。

text_en: Night and day among the tombs and on the mountains he was always howling and bruising himself with stones.
text_cn: 他昼夜在墓坟里或山陵中喊叫，用石头击伤自己。

text_en: When he saw Jesus from a distance, he ran and bowed down before him;
text_cn: 他从远处望见了耶稣，就跑来，跪在他前，

text_en: and he shouted at the top of his voice, “What have you to do with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, do not torment me. ”
text_cn: 大声喊说：“至高天主之子耶稣，我与你有什么相干？我因着天主誓求你，不要苦害我！”

text_en: For he had said to him, “Come out of the man, you unclean spirit! ”
text_cn: 因为耶稣曾向他说：“邪魔，从这人身上出去！”

text_en: Then Jesus asked him, “What is your name? ” He replied, “My name is Legion; for we are many. ”
text_cn: 耶稣问他说：“你名叫什么？”他回答说：“我名叫‘军旅’，因为我们众多。”

text_en: He begged him earnestly not to send them out of the country.
text_cn: 他再三恳求耶稣，不要驱逐他们离开此地。

text_en: Now there on the hillside a great herd of swine was feeding;
text_cn: 那时，在那边山坡上，有一大群猪正在牧放，

text_en: and the unclean spirits begged him, “Send us into the swine; let us enter them. ”
text_cn: 他们恳求耶稣说：“请打发我们到那猪群，好让我们进入它们内。”

text_en: So he gave them permission. And the unclean spirits came out and entered the swine; and the herd, numbering about two thousand, rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and were drowned in the sea.
text_cn: 耶稣准许了他们；邪魔就出来，进入了猪内。那群猪约有二千，便从山崖上直冲到海里，在海里淹死了。

text_en: The swineherds ran off and told it in the city and in the country. Then people came to see what it was that had happened.
text_cn: 放猪的人就逃去，到城里和乡间传报开了；人都出来看是发生了什么事。

text_en: They came to Jesus and saw the demoniac sitting there, clothed and in his right mind, the very man who had had the legion; and they were afraid.
text_cn: 他们来到耶稣跟前，看见那个附魔的人，即为“军旅”所附的人，坐在那里，穿着衣服，神志清醒，就害怕起来。

text_en: Those who had seen what had happened to the demoniac and to the swine reported it.
text_cn: 看见的人就把附魔的人所遇到的事，和那群猪的事，都给他们述说了。

text_en: Then they began to beg Jesus to leave their neighborhood.
text_cn: 他们便请求耶稣离开他们的境界。

text_en: As he was getting into the boat, the man who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.
text_cn: 当耶稣上船时，那曾附过魔的人，恳求耶稣让他同耶稣在一起。

text_en: But Jesus refused, and said to him, “Go home to your friends, and tell them how much the Lord has done for you, and what mercy he has shown you. ”
text_cn: 耶稣没有允许他，但对他说：“你回家，到你的亲属那里，给他们传述上主为你作了何等大事，怎样怜悯了你。”

text_en: And he went away and began to proclaim in the Decapolis how much Jesus had done for him; and everyone was amazed.
text_cn: 那人就走了，在十城区开始传扬耶稣为他所作的何等大事，众人都惊奇不已。

text_en: When Jesus had crossed again in the boat to the other side, a great crowd gathered around him; and he was by the sea.
text_cn: 耶稣乘船又渡回对岸，有大伙群众聚集在他周围；他遂留在海滨。

text_en: Then one of the leaders of the synagogue named Jairus came and, when he saw him, fell at his feet
text_cn: 那时，来了一个会堂长，名叫雅依洛，一见耶稣，就跪伏在他脚前，

text_en: and begged him repeatedly, “My little daughter is at the point of death. Come and lay your hands on her, so that she may be made well, and live. ”
text_cn: 恳切求他说：“我的小女儿快要死了，请你来，给她覆手，叫她得救回生。”

text_en: So he went with him. And a large crowd followed him and pressed in on him.
text_cn: 耶稣就同他去了。有一大群人跟随着他，拥挤着他。

text_en: Now there was a woman who had been suffering from hemorrhages for twelve years.
text_cn: 那时，有一个妇人，患血漏已有十二年。

text_en: She had endured much under many physicians, and had spent all that she had; and she was no better, but rather grew worse.
text_cn: 她在许多医生手里，受了许多痛苦，花尽了自己所有的一切，不但没有见效，反而病势更加重了。

text_en: She had heard about Jesus, and came up behind him in the crowd and touched his cloak,
text_cn: 她听了有关耶稣的传说，便来到人群中，从后边摸了耶稣的衣裳，

text_en: for she said, “If I but touch his clothes, I will be made well. ”
text_cn: 因为她心里想：“我只要一摸他的衣裳，必然会好的。”

text_en: Immediately her hemorrhage stopped; and she felt in her body that she was healed of her disease.
text_cn: 她的血源立刻涸(hé)竭(jié)了，并且觉得身上的疾病也好了。

text_en: Immediately aware that power had gone forth from him, Jesus turned about in the crowd and said, “Who touched my clothes? ”
text_cn: 耶稣立时觉得有一种能力从自己身上出去，就在人群中回过头来说：“谁摸了我的衣裳？”

text_en: And his disciples said to him, “You see the crowd pressing in on you; how can you say, ‘Who touched me? ’”
text_cn: 他的门徒向他说：“你看！群众四面拥挤着你，你还问：谁摸了我？”

text_en: He looked all around to see who had done it.
text_cn: 耶稣四周观望，要看作这事的妇人。

text_en: But the woman, knowing what had happened to her, came in fear and trembling, fell down before him, and told him the whole truth.
text_cn: 那妇人明知在自己身上所成的事，就战战兢兢地前来，跪伏在耶稣前，把实情完全告诉了他。

text_en: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well; go in peace, and be healed of your disease. ”
text_cn: 耶稣便向她说：“女儿，你的信德救了你，平安去罢！你的疾病必得痊愈！”

text_en: While he was still speaking, some people came from the leader’s house to say, “Your daughter is dead. Why trouble the teacher any further? ”
text_cn: 他还说话的时候，有人从会堂长家里来，说：“你的女儿死了，你还来烦劳师傅做什么？”

text_en: But overhearing what they said, Jesus said to the leader of the synagogue, “Do not fear, only believe. ”
text_cn: 耶稣听见所说的话，就给会堂长说：“不要怕，只管信。”

text_en: He allowed no one to follow him except Peter, James, and John, the brother of James.
text_cn: 除伯多禄、雅各伯和雅各伯的弟弟若望外，他没有让任何人跟他去。

text_en: When they came to the house of the leader of the synagogue, he saw a commotion, people weeping and wailing loudly.
text_cn: 他们到了会堂长的家里，耶稣看见群众非常喧噪：有的哭泣，有的哀号，

text_en: When he had entered, he said to them, “Why do you make a commotion and weep? The child is not dead but sleeping. ”
text_cn: 便进去，给他们说：“你们为什么喧噪哭泣呢？小女孩并没有死，只是睡着了！”

text_en: And they laughed at him. Then he put them all outside, and took the child’s father and mother and those who were with him, and went in where the child was.
text_cn: 他们都讥笑他。他却把众人赶出去，带着小女孩的父亲和母亲，及同他在一起的人，进了小女孩所在的地方。

text_en: He took her by the hand and said to her, “Talitha cum, ” which means, “Little girl, get up! ”
text_cn: 他拿起小女孩的手，对她说：“塔里塔，古木！”意思是：“女孩子，我命你起来！”

text_en: And immediately the girl got up and began to walk about (she was twelve years of age). At this they were overcome with amazement.
text_cn: 那女孩子就立刻起来行走，原来她已十二岁了；他们都惊讶得目瞪口呆。

text_en: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and told them to give her something to eat.
text_cn: 耶稣却严厉命令他们，不要叫任何人知道这事；又吩咐给女孩子吃的。
